statement: Accepted checks and known failures are preserved in separate explicit classifications; failed checks are never counted as accepted or omitted from totals.
notes: The eleven final compatibility checks comprise eight rendered fixture passes, two current-runtime armour-threshold failures, and one Forward+ effect-geometry parity pass.
Two additional frozen-9773 cape-solver reproductions fail the same four armour penetration thresholds. The GL measurements match exactly; Forward+ differs by at most 1 mm per frame.

All four failed armour records are retained individually and are not counted as accepted passes. The baseline reproductions establish that the two current-runtime failures are inherited fixture failures rather than regressions introduced by the optimized cape solver.
Evidence was captured with task-local user data and affinity mask 15 on a shared host; foreign activity was authorized and not continuously monitored.
